sentences.text: Chomatodus was a member of the class Chondrichthyes, a group that includes sharks and rays.
This species belongs to the family Petalodontidae.
The genus was first described by Louis Agassiz in 1838.
It lived between 351.9 and 293.52 million years ago during the Tournaisian to Asselian stages.
Fossil remains have been discovered in the Keokuk Limestone in Keokuk, Iowa, United States.
